question: In 1955, _____ noted the possibility of using small-scale industries for promoting rural development.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Karve Committee.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Karve Committee, also known as the **Village and Small-Scale Industries Committee**, noted the possibility of using small-scale industries for promoting rural development in **1955.**
 
• The Planning Commission (now NITI AYOG) set up the committee** to study the potential of small-scale industries **for rural development.
 
• The committee was named after its head,** Dattatreya Gopal Karve.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sarkaria Committee**

 
 
• Formed in **1983** to review the functioning of the** Centre-State relations** in India.
 
• Primarily dealt with constitutional issues rather than rural development or small-scale industries.
 
 
 
• **Kelkar Committee**
 
 
• Kelkar committee was formed in India to study and evaluate the extant** public-private partnership (PPP) **model in India.
 
• The committee was set up by India's central government and headed by **Vijay Kelkar.**
 
 **Chakravarty Committee**

 
 
• Set up in** 1985** to examine the** impact of economic reforms** on the Indian economy.
 
• Primarily dealt with macroeconomic issues and policy recommendations rather than rural development through small-scale industries.
